intro.label: About us
intro.title: We turn complex processes into technology that simply works.
intro.imageAlt: A team meeting around a conference table

statement.label: Who we are
statement.text: ZIIV stands for Zero-Interface Intelligence & Vision. We build software that *disappears into the work*, so teams spend less time fighting their systems and *more time moving the business forward*.

values.label: Our values
values.title: The principles behind every build.
values.text: We want ZIIV to feel intelligent without being complicated, ambitious without losing sight of the people who use what we make. These values guide the decisions we make on every project, from the first conversation to long after launch.

principles.label: Why ZIIV
principles.title: What you can expect from us.

items.name: Outcomes first
items.text: Every feature has to earn its place by solving a real business problem.

items.name: Built to last
items.text: Clean architecture and maintainable code, so your system can grow with you.

items.name: Practical AI
items.text: We use intelligence where it removes friction, never just for show.

items.name: Partners, not vendors
items.text: Plain-language updates, honest trade-offs and support after launch.

horizons.label: Where we’re headed
horizons.title: Starting at home, building for further.

items.name: Ghana
items.text: Our starting point and initial focus: helping local businesses and institutions work better.

items.name: Africa
items.text: Opportunities across the continent for software that fits how businesses here operate.

items.name: International
items.text: Partnerships and clients beyond Africa who want a dependable engineering team.
